title: Connect ChatGPT to Genie One with the Databricks Genie plugin
body: The Databricks Genie plugin connects ChatGPT to the Genie One MCP, so users can ask questions about their data from ChatGPT. A ChatGPT admin sets up the plugin for the ChatGPT workspace, and each user connects by signing in with their Databricks account. See [Databricks Genie plugins for ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok Bot/Cursor](/aws/en/agents/mcp-tools/genie-mcp#genie-plugins).
